questions.q: 'The late Mr. Karim was a famous poet.' — Here the word 'late' is used as a/an—
questions.e: এখানে late = প্রয়াত, noun (Mr. Karim)-কে বিশেষিত করছে, তাই adjective; ‘He came late’-এ late adverb।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'He dug a well behind his house.' — Here the word 'well' is used as a/an—
questions.e: a well = কূপ — article-যুক্ত নামবাচক শব্দ, তাই noun।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Still waters run deep.' — Here the word 'Still' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'The earth moves round the sun.' — Here the word 'round' is used as a/an—
questions.e: round এখানে the sun (object)-এর সঙ্গে সম্পর্ক স্থাপন করছে — preposition।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'I have known him since 2010.' — Here the word 'since' is used as a/an—
questions.e: since + সময়বাচক noun → preposition; since + clause → conjunction।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Since you are tired, you may rest.' — Here the word 'Since' is used as a/an—
questions.e: since এখানে দুটি clause যুক্ত করছে (কারণ অর্থে) — conjunction।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'I have seen this film before.' — Here the word 'before' is used as a/an—
questions.e: before-এর পরে কোনো object বা clause নেই — adverb।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'He is the only son of his parents.' — Here the word 'only' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'He is old enough to vote.' — Here the word 'enough' is used as a/an—
questions.e: enough এখানে adjective (old)-কে বিশেষিত করছে — adverb; ‘enough money’-তে adjective।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'This is the very book I was looking for.' — Here the word 'very' is used as a/an—
questions.e: the very + noun = ঠিক সেই — এখানে very adjective।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Please light the candle.' — Here the word 'light' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Hurrah! We have won the match.' — Here the word 'Hurrah' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Swimming is a good exercise.' — Here the word 'Swimming' is used as a/an—
questions.e: V-ing এখানে subject হিসেবে noun-এর কাজ করছে (gerund)।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'The rich should help the poor.' — Here the word 'rich' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'She bought a gold necklace.' — Here the word 'gold' is used as a/an—
questions.e: gold এখানে necklace-কে বিশেষিত করছে (material adjective)।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Both of them passed the exam.' — Here the word 'Both' is used as a/an—
questions.e: both of them — এখানে both নিজেই noun-এর পরিবর্তে বসেছে — pronoun।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Either road leads to the station.' — Here the word 'Either' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'He is poor, yet he is honest.' — Here the word 'yet' is used as a/an—
questions.e: yet দুটি clause যুক্ত করছে (বৈপরীত্য) — conjunction।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'He must be ill, for he is absent today.' — Here the word 'for' is used as a/an—
questions.e: for এখানে কারণ বোঝাতে দুটি clause যুক্ত করছে।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Wait here till I come back.' — Here the word 'till' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'You will fail unless you work hard.' — Here the word 'unless' is used as a/an—
questions.e: unless (যদি না) দুটি clause যুক্ত করছে।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'He left his umbrella behind.' — Here the word 'behind' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'The children went inside.' — Here the word 'inside' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Considering his age, he did very well.' — Here the word 'Considering' is used as a/an—
questions.e: considering = বিবেচনায় — এখানে preposition হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'The decision was postponed pending the inquiry.' — Here the word 'pending' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Notwithstanding the rain, the match continued.' — Here the word 'Notwithstanding' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Alas! He is no more.' — Here the word 'Alas' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'That bag is mine.' — Here the word 'That' is used as a/an—
questions.e: That এখানে bag (noun)-এর আগে বসে নির্দেশ করছে — demonstrative adjective।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'He spoke loudly in the meeting.' — Here the word 'loudly' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'They themselves repaired the roof.' — Here the word 'themselves' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Whose pen is this?' — Here the word 'Whose' is used as a/an—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: How many parts of speech are there in traditional English grammar?
questions.e: প্রচলিত ব্যাকরণে parts of speech ৮টি: Noun, Pronoun, Adjective, Verb, Adverb, Preposition, Conjunction, Interjection।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: A word that modifies a verb, an adjective or another adverb is called—
questions.e: adverb verb, adjective বা অন্য adverb-কে বিশেষিত করে।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: A word used instead of a noun is called—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: A word that joins words, phrases or clauses is called—
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: A word placed before a noun or pronoun to show its relation to another word is—
questions.e: noun/pronoun-এর আগে বসে সম্পর্ক বোঝায় = preposition।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: Which of the following words can be used both as a noun and as a verb?
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: Which word is NOT an adjective?
questions.e: happily = adverb; friendly, lovely -ly থাকলেও adjective।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: Which of the following is an adverb?
questions.e: seldom = কদাচিৎ (adverb); silly, costly, elderly adjective।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: Which of the following is a preposition?
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: Which word is a conjunction?
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: In which sentence is 'round' used as a noun?
o: They sat at a round table.
The guard made his round of the building.
questions.e: a round (টহল/এক দফা) — article-সহ noun; অন্যগুলোতে adjective, adverb ও preposition।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: In which sentence is 'still' used as a verb?
o: The mother tried to still the crying baby.
questions.e: still the baby = শান্ত করা — verb।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: In which sentence is 'since' used as an adverb?
o: He left the town in 2015 and has not been seen since.
Since you insist, I will go.
questions.e: বাক্যের শেষে object বা clause ছাড়া since = adverb।
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: In which sentence is 'better' used as a verb?
o: We must try to better our results.
questions.src: Lecture 05–08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)
